findings.evidence_quote_or_span: guard first.statusCode == 401 else { return first }; accessToken = try await auth.refresh()
findings.why_it_is_a_defect: Concurrent 401s can start independent refreshes and publish rotated tokens out of order.
findings.recommended_change: Serialize credential state, coalesce refreshes per session, and publish only the current-generation token before one bounded replay.
findings.authority_or_scope_note: AuthService may provide this internally, but the client contract does not show it.

findings.why_it_is_a_defect: Logout does not invalidate or cancel in-flight sends before awaiting, so stale work can refresh and retry after logout.
findings.recommended_change: Serialize session transitions, invalidate before await, and generation-gate prior refresh/replay completions.
findings.authority_or_scope_note: Concurrency/lifecycle defect when send and logout may overlap.

findings.evidence_quote_or_span: return try await transport.send(request, accessToken: accessToken)
findings.why_it_is_a_defect: No cancellation check prevents refresh/replay after caller cancellation when dependencies complete normally.
findings.recommended_change: Check cancellation before refresh and replay and require dependency cancellation propagation.
findings.authority_or_scope_note: Conditional on caller cancellation and dependency behavior.

findings.evidence_quote_or_span: guard first.statusCode == 401 ... return try await transport.send(request, accessToken: accessToken)
findings.why_it_is_a_defect: Replay has no proof of body replayability, operation idempotency, or backend safety.
findings.recommended_change: Make replayability/idempotency explicit and replay only under the backend token-rotation contract.
findings.authority_or_scope_note: Conditional contract gap, not a claim that one retry is always wrong.

controls_not_defects: Exactly one replay after 401 is valid when rotation and replay safety are guaranteed.
unknowns: AuthService serialization, actor use, request semantics, and backend contract are unspecified.
